raw.title: Knit - Research Manager
raw.description:
Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

  • Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

  • Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

  • Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

  • Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

  • Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.

  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.

  • Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.

description: Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern verstehen, wie aus einer Idee ein Produkt wird, das Kund:innen wirklich nachkaufen? Die MainTea GmbH ist ein Food-Startup aus Frankfurt am Main mit rund 30 Mitarbeitenden und Teil der MainTea-Gruppe. Zur Gruppe gehören mehrere Marken: Besser im Glas (D2C), PRO2BE , Bubble Pop und Bubble Chill , jeweils im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Die Produktentwicklung arbeitet für alle diese Marken, und genau dort bist du in deinem Pflichtpraktikum fest im Team: Du verkostest, recherchierst Trends, stimmst dich mit Herstellern und Lieferanten ab und begleitest neue Produkte von der ersten Idee bis ins Regal. Wenn du Food liebst und in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien echte Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Deine Aufgaben Produktentwicklung über alle Marken: Du arbeitest aktiv an Neuentwicklungen und Sortimentserweiterungen für Besser im Glas und PRO2BE, von Tee- und Gewürzmischungen über Protein-Produkte bis zu Getränken. Verkostung & Produkttests: Du planst und organisierst strukturierte Verkostungen, wertest Geschmack, Aroma, Textur und Optik aus und lieferst Feedback, das direkt in die Weiterentwicklung einfließt. Trendrecherche & Marktbeobachtung: Du behältst Food- und Getränketrends im Blick, beobachtest Wettbewerber im Onlinehandel und im Supermarkt und bringst eigene Ideen für neue Sorten und Konzepte ein. Besorgungen & Testlogistik: Du besorgst Testzutaten und Vergleichsprodukte und sorgst dafür, dass bei Verkostungen alles bereitsteht. Dokumentation: Du hältst Ergebnisse sauber fest und machst Fortschritte für das Team nachvollziehbar. Dein Profil Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in und musst im Rahmen deines Studiums ein Pflichtpraktikum von mindestens 6 Monaten absolvieren. Idealerweise studierst du Ökotrophologie, Lebensmitteltechnologie, Lebensmittelchemie, Food Management oder etwas Vergleichbares. Du brennst für Food, neue Produkte und Trends und probierst gern Neues aus. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Geschmack und ein Auge fürs Detail. Team & Kultur: Ein offenes, vertrauensvolles und humorvolles Team, regelmäßige Teamevents und viel Hands-on-Mentalität. Work-Life-Balance: 24 Urlaubstage und ein strukturiertes, modernes Arbeitsumfeld. KI & Tools: Zugang zu modernen Arbeitsmitteln und KI — damit du von Anfang an effizient arbeiten kannst. description: Als Leiter Betrieb und Sicherheit (m/w/d) verantwortest du das operative Herz von FlixTrain: von der Betriebs- und Produktionsplanung über die Leitstelle, die in Echtzeit den Betrieb steuert, bis hin zur Betriebssicherheit, der Flottendisposition sowie dem Partner- und Qualitätsmanagement. Du sorgst für einen sicheren, pünktlichen, zuverlässigen und kundenfreundlichen Zugbetrieb und baust das Führungsteam über alle operativen Funktionen hinweg auf – mit direkter Berichtslinie an den CEO. Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die unternehmerisch handelt und entscheidet, für die Sache brennt, mit anpackt und Lust am Aufbau von Strukturen, Prozessen und Optimierungen hat. Bei uns kannst du den Betrieb des größten privaten Fernverkehrsplayers in Deutschland aufbauen. Über die Rolle Du verantwortest Betriebsplanung, Produktionskonzepte sowie Schicht- und Personaleinsatzplanung für einen zuverlässigen und sicheren Betrieb. Du führst die Leitstelle und steuerst damit den laufenden Betrieb, das Störungs- und Abweichungsmanagement sowie die Disposition des Personals – mit ruhigem Kopf in jeder betrieblichen Lage. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Safety Manager die Eisenbahnsicherheit, die regulatorische Compliance und die Sicherheitskultur – inklusive der Safety-Teams und Betriebskontrolleure. Du stellst die Flottenverfügbarkeit und Flottendisposition sicher – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Instandhaltungspartnern, die als zentrale Ressource gestellt werden. Du definierst unsere Servicestandards und die operative Qualität und sorgst für deren kontinuierliche Optimierung – inklusive Sauberkeit, Reinigung sowie Ver- und Entsorgung. Du steuerst operative Partner und Subunternehmer, entwickelst einheitliche Standards mit Partner-EVUs, optimierst Schnittstellen und treibst Prozessexzellenz voran. Du definierst mit deinem Team die Anforderungen an unsere Software-Entwicklung, Automatisierung und Digitalisierung von Abläufen, harmonisierst die Software-Landschaft und sorgst für eine gute Anwendbarkeit über alle Funktionen hinweg. Du verantwortest das operative Budget und die entscheidenden KPIs – etwa Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit, Pünktlichkeit, Sauberkeit, Schichtbesetzung und Flottenverfügbarkeit. Über Dich Du bringst ein unternehmerisches Mindset und echte Leidenschaft fürs Aufbauen mit – du brennst für das Ergebnis und packst mit an, um es Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen. Du hast insgesamt rund zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung gesammelt und in dieser Zeit Verantwortung und Gestaltungskraft aufgebaut. Erfahrung im Eisenbahnumfeld ist für uns gesetzt – idealerweise verbunden mit operativem Verständnis für Disposition und Planung. Du bringst Führungserfahrung in operativen Funktionen sowie Erfahrung im Aufbau von Teams und Strukturen mit. Du verfügst über verhandlungssicheres Deutsch. Idealerweise hast du dein Handwerk bei der Eisenbahn von Grund auf gelernt und dich anschließend weiterentwickelt – zum Beispiel über eine Station in der Beratung hin zu einer Führungsrolle im operativen Umfeld. Wünschenswert sind außerdem: Erfahrung im Skalieren von Betrieben in einem Wachstumsumfeld, ein Hintergrund in Eisenbahn-Sicherheitsmanagementsystemen (SMS) und Erfahrung im Flottenmanagement. Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Was Wir Bieten Gestaltungsspielraum mit Mandat : Eine Schlüsselrolle mit direkter Berichtslinie an den CEO und dem Auftrag, den Betrieb des größten privaten Fernverkehrsanbieters Deutschlands maßgeblich aufzubauen – dein Einfluss ist unmittelbar sichtbar. Vertrauensarbeitszeit : Wir arbeiten ergebnisorientiert und messen an dem, was du bewegst – nicht an der Stechuhr. Hybrides Arbeitsmodell : Drei Tage Office und zwei Tage remote pro Woche – für die Nähe zum Team und die Flexibilität, die eine Führungsrolle braucht. 30 Tage Urlaub: Zeit zum Abschalten und Auftanken Arbeiten von Überall: Zusätzlich kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten. Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. Lernen & Entwicklung : Sprachkurse, Schulungen, Experten-Sessions sowie ein Mentoring-Programm mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, um deine Wirkung weiter auszubauen. Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. Warum Teil von Flix werden? Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Mit aussagekräftigen Auswertungen und Reportings unterstützt du die Personalplanung und schaffst eine verlässliche Grundlage für Entscheidungen. Darüberhinaus bringst du dich und deine Expertise aktiv in unterschiedliche Projekte innerhalb der HR-Themenlandschaft ein. Produktentwicklung und Roadmap-Erstellung: Verbesserungschancen identifizieren: Identifiziere Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung des digitalen Produkts auf Grundlage von Kundenfeedback, Marktentwicklungen, geschäftlichen Prioritäten und technischen Möglichkeiten. Produktvision verfeinern: Wirke an der kontinuierlichen Verfeinerung der Produktvision, des Wertversprechens und der Ausrichtung der Features mit, damit das Produkt nachhaltig messbaren Mehrwert liefert. Funktionsübergreifende technische Zusammenarbeit: Brücke zwischen Business und Technik: Agieren Sie als Schnittstelle zwischen den geschäftlichen Stakeholdern und den technischen Teams und sorgen Sie für eine starke Abstimmung zwischen den Produktzielen und der technischen Umsetzung. Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 7 Jahre nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Manager oder Technical Product Manager mit starker Eigenverantwortung für digitale Produkte über Roadmap-Umsetzung, Delivery und kontinuierliche Produktentwicklung hinweg. Komplexe Tech-Produkte: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von KI-gestützten, datengesteuerten oder anderweitig technisch komplexen digitalen Produkten oder IT-Lösungen. Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssicheres Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich; sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus. Nice-to-haves: Vorherige Erfahrung in einem Start-up- oder Scale-up-Umfeld. Hintergrund in KI-Produkten, Lösungen auf Basis von maschinellem Lernen oder intelligenter Automatisierung. Vertrautheit mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und der iterativen Produktentwicklung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-Teams. title: Marketing & Communications Manager (m/w/d)
description: Du möchtest nicht einfach Marketing machen. Du möchtest etwas bewegen. Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und aus guten Ideen etwas Konkretes zu machen? Du bist neugierig, stellst Fragen und probierst auch mal neue Wege aus? Und Du findest, dass gute Ergebnisse am besten gemeinsam entstehen? Dann könnten wir gut zusammenpassen. Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur einen Marketingplan abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt, Dinge hinterfragt und Lust hat, mit uns etwas zu gestalten. Dabei glauben wir an klare Worte, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und hohe Ansprüche an unsere Arbeit. Wir nehmen unsere Aufgaben ernst – uns selbst aber nicht immer. Und wir sind überzeugt, dass Professionalität und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören. Über OIXIO OIXIO gehört zu den führenden IT-Anbietern Estlands – einem Land, das wie kaum ein anderes in Europa für gelebte Digitalisierung und einen hohen Stellenwert von Cybersecurity steht. Was dort über viele Jahre gewachsen ist, bringen wir jetzt verstärkt nach Deutschland: technologische Kompetenz, pragmatische Lösungen, direkte Zusammenarbeit und die Überzeugung, dass gute Digitalisierung vor allem eines tun muss – funktionieren. Mit OIXIO erminas verbinden wir diesen estnischen Spirit mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung mit deutschen Hidden Champions im Mittelstand und unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT sicher, verlässlich und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen – von Cybersecurity und IT-Infrastruktur über Business-Anwendungen und Cloud bis zu Daten, KI und Industrial IoT. In Deutschland stehen wir mit unserer gemeinsamen Geschichte noch am Anfang – und kaum jemand kennt hier bisher unseren Namen. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der das ändern will und lieber etwas aufbaut, als eine fertige Rolle zu übernehmen. Die Aufgabe Als Marketing & Communications Manager Deutschland machst Du OIXIO bei mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen bekannt und vertrauenswürdig – vor allem in Norddeutschland und Nordrhein-Westfalen – und schaffst die Gespräche, auf denen unser Vertrieb aufbaut. Du entwickelst unsere Botschaften für den deutschen Markt und übersetzt unser Angebot in klare Geschichten für IT, Produktion und Geschäftsführung. Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Account Manager steuerst Du gezielte Kampagnen für eine definierte Liste von Zielunternehmen und machst aus Interesse konkrete Gespräche. Du baust die Präsenz von OIXIO auf LinkedIn auf – für das Unternehmen sowie für unsere Expertinnen, Experten und Geschäftsführung. Du pflegst Kontakte zu Fach- und Regionalmedien und platzierst Artikel, Fachbeiträge und Kundengeschichten. Du organisierst eigene Veranstaltungen – vom Kundenfrühstück im Werk über Webinare bis zu Roundtables – und wählst die Messen und Netzwerkveranstaltungen aus, auf denen wir präsent sind. Du erstellst Inhalte, die überzeugen: Case Studies, One-Pager, Präsentationen, Videos und Webinhalte – gemeinsam mit unseren Fachleuten in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen. Du misst, was wirkt – Website-Besuche, Anfragen, Veranstaltungsteilnahmen, aktivierte Zielunternehmen und Vertriebstermine – und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM. Unsere Themen: Cybersecurity, Informationssicherheit, Managed IT Services, Microsoft Business Central/NAV-Modernisierung, Prozessdigitalisierung, Industrial IoT, Cloud, Daten und KI. Was Du mitbringen solltest Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing oder in der Unternehmenskommunikation, idealerweise mit IT-Services, Managed Services, Industrieautomation, Beratung oder Business-Anwendungen. Nachweisbare Erfolge darin, Sichtbarkeit aufzubauen und Nachfrage zu erzeugen – gerne auch als erste oder einzige Marketingverantwortliche in einem Unternehmen oder Markt. Erfahrung mit Kampagnen für konkrete Zielunternehmen und mehrere Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider auf Kundenseite. Gutes Verständnis für mittelständische Unternehmen, besonders im industriellen Umfeld, und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären. Starke Schreibkompetenz, sicherer Umgang mit LinkedIn, CRM und Web-Analytics, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gutes Englisch. Du kennst die wichtigsten Werkzeuge des modernen B2B-Marketings und weißt, wie Du ihre Wirkung misst. Ob Dynamics 365, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Analytics, SEO-Tools oder KI: Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du jedes Tool bereits beherrschst, sondern dass Du weißt, was Du erreichen willst, und Dich schnell in neue Werkzeuge einarbeiten kannst. Flexibler Wohnort in Norddeutschland, sofern regelmäßige persönliche Treffen mit dem Team in unserem Büro in Oldenburg gut möglich sind; Reisebereitschaft deutschlandweit, gelegentlich auch nach Estland und Litauen. Was gut zu uns passt Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen. Ein komplett bestelltes Feld brauchst Du nicht – im Gegenteil: Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, entwickelst Ideen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, daraus etwas zu machen. Du bist neugierig auf Menschen, Unternehmen und Technologien und willst verstehen, bevor Du kommunizierst. Du schätzt Flexibilität, möchtest aber nicht ausschließlich im Homeoffice arbeiten. Der persönliche Austausch im Team, mit unseren Kunden und mit der Presse ist Dir wichtig. Du kannst die Stärke und Erfahrung einer etablierten internationalen IT-Gruppe nutzen und gleichzeitig mit uns herausfinden, was davon für den deutschen Mittelstand wirklich relevant ist. Du arbeitest eigenständig, aber nicht als Einzelkämpfer. Bei uns ist Marketing Teamsport: Gute Ergebnisse entstehen gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Consultants, Technik und Geschäftsführung. Du misst Deinen Erfolg at Gesprächen und Kunden – nicht an Likes – und versprichst nichts, was unser Team nicht halten kann. Und Du hast Lust, ein Stück des OIXIO Spirits aus Estland nach Deutschland zu bringen – und ihm hier gemeinsam mit uns eine eigene Handschrift zu geben. Was wir bieten Eine konkrete Rolle beim Aufbau von OIXIO in Deutschland – mit Gestaltungsspielraum und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Ein echtes Budget für Veranstaltungen, Inhalte und Medienarbeit sowie Unterstützung durch Spezialisten, wo es nötig ist. Erfahrene Fachleute in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen, die Inhalte, Demos und Vorträge beisteuern. Ein breites Leistungsportfolio rund um IT, Cybersecurity, Digitalisierung, Business-Anwendungen und Industrial IoT – mit vielen Geschichten, die erzählt werden wollen. Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit estnischer Bodenständigkeit, direkter Kommunikation und pragmatischer Zusammenarbeit. Wir erwarten viel und geben auch viel zurück: Vertrauen, Freiraum, faire Bedingungen und Menschen, auf die Du Dich verlassen kannst. Warum diese Rolle interessant ist Deutschland ist für OIXIO ein wichtiger Wachstumsmarkt. Mit unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg, einem erfahrenen Team und einem relevanten Angebot passen wir gut zu den Herausforderungen vieler mittelständischer Industrieunternehmen – jetzt muss es der Markt nur noch erfahren. Wenn Du Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing mitbringst, Lust hast, eine Marke von Grund auf bekannt zu machen, und lieber mit einem guten Team als mit großen Schlagworten arbeitest, freuen wir uns auf das Gespräch mit Dir. raw.title: Founder / CEO
raw.description:
About Spira Labs

Spira Labs is an early-stage TechBio and HealthTech venture builder based in Munich, Germany.
Backed by Picus Capital and Arvantis Group, and supported by leading industry experts, we partner with exceptional founders from the earliest stages to turn ambitious ideas into scalable healthcare and life science companies.

We focus on data- and AI-driven business models across diagnostics, life sciences and healthcare delivery, combining deep domain expertise with hands-on support across the early-stage phases, from product development to go-to-market.

We are looking for an exceptional entrepreneur to take the lead in one of our incubated ventures, building a next-generation diagnostics company at the intersection of metagenomics, data science and precision medicine. The ambition is to combine increasingly accessible sequencing technology with advanced bioinformatics to develop clinically meaningful products while building a proprietary data foundation for future diagnostic applications.

What you will do

As Founder / CEO, you will take the helm of a fast-moving startup, leveraging the declining cost of metagenomic sequencing to build a category-leading, data-driven molecular diagnostics platform.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Define and execute the company's vision, strategy and product roadmap

  • Drive scientific validation, product development and commercialization

  • Build and lead a high-performing team and build out strategic partnerships with labs

  • Drive commercial growth, fundraising and investor relations

  • Take full ownership of company execution, operations and performance

Your profile

  • Strong background in data-driven / digital healthcare, diagnostics or precision medicine

  • Experience in healthcare or diagnostic product development and/or commercialization, ideally with exposure to laboratory workflows, clinical validation and/or regulatory requirements (MDR/IVDR)

  • Solid scientific and analytical judgment, with the ability to critically assess clinical evidence, technical feasibility and commercial potential

  • Strong commercial acumen, ideally with experience in go-to-market, sales, partnerships or early customer traction in healthcare or life sciences

  • Entrepreneurial experience in building products, businesses or new initiatives from the ground up, ideally in resource-constrained environments

  • Inspiring and credible leader with the ability to attract exceptional talent, build high-performing teams and establish strong industry relationships

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex science into compelling products, business opportunities and investor narratives

  • High agency, ownership mindset and evidence-driven decision-making

What we offer

  • Opportunity to build and lead a company at the intersection of metagenomics, AI and precision medicine, with meaningful founder equity

  • Direct access to experienced entrepreneurs, investors, clinicians and scientists across the Spira Labs, Picus Capital and Arvantis Group networks

  • Ongoing partnership discussions with three leading diagnostic laboratories in Germany, providing a strong foundation for scientific validation, product development and commercialization

  • Hands-on venture-building support, initial funding and access to operational resources and expertise

  • High degree of entrepreneurial autonomy, with a lean team, fast decision-making and the freedom to shape the company from day one

  • Flexible working arrangements and an attractive office in central Munich

title: People Analytics Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Our Vision

To be the strategic engine room of Raisin’s People & Culture team—building the secure, data-driven, and innovative infrastructure that empowers our people and scales the organization.

Our Mission

We bridge the gap between people strategy and the technology that powers it. We ensure Raisin is future-ready, fair, and fully compliant by focusing on four core pillars:

  • People Systems: We manage and evolve our HRIS landscape so P&C can focus on people, not manual processes.
  • People Analytics: We leverage people analytics and AI automation to guide smarter business decisions, driving equity through modern Total Rewards frameworks.
  • People Governance: We act as P&C’s compliance anchor—taking ownership of audit requests, people policy and process transformation, and risk management (TPRM) to keep our infrastructure secure.


Your Responsibilities

  • We are looking for a People Analytics Manager to own the data, reporting, and insights of Raisin’s People function.
  • You will ensure smooth operations of our HR reporting systems and be the main point of contact for data-driven insights and analytics requests within our People tooling stack.
  • You will build and maintain Raisin’s People dashboards and reports to meet the business needs based on the requirements of the People business functions and in close alignment with the People Solutions leadership.
  • You will look after the data modeling, trend analysis, and predictive analytics related to our workforce.
  • You will support seamless integrations of People data pipelines in close alignment with People and Culture leadership and other stakeholders.
  • You will own the documentation of HR metrics, data definitions, and reporting structures across Raisin’s People applications.

Your Profile

  • You hold a university degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related field, or bring equivalent experience with a strong analytical background.
  • You have 5+ years of hands-on experience in People Analytics, Business Intelligence, or data analysis.
  • You are able to translate complex data sets into clear narratives and actionable insights for business leaders.
  • You have strong People domain knowledge incl. People processes across the employee lifecycle.
  • You are highly responsible, trustworthy, and adept at handling sensitive and confidential data with the utmost discretion.
  • You have strong communication skills and you feel comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You are fluent in English.
  • Experience with our tooling stack (especially with data visualization tools like Looker Studio and HRIS like Personio) is a plus.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

  • Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
  • Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
  • A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
  • Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. 
  • Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
  • Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
  • Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
  • You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Engineering Lead – AI Enablement (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

AI Enablement builds Raisin's internal AI platform. We make it easy and safe for every team, from engineering and product to business operations, to use AI in their daily work and in the products they build.

We provide the shared foundation for that: governed access to AI models and tools, the controls that keep data secure and usage auditable, and the visibility teams need to run AI reliably and cost-effectively. We also shape how Raisin builds software with AI, from AI-assisted coding to agentic workflows that support teams across the development lifecycle. Because Raisin operates in regulated financial services, security and compliance are core to how we design the platform.

The team is growing, and you will shape both what it builds and how it works.

Your Responsibilities

As Engineering Lead, you lead the engineers who build Raisin's internal AI platform and drive the company's AI-assisted engineering practices. You are accountable for the team's delivery, growth, and maintaining the AI platform users' trust. 

You stay close to the technology, because in a field that changes this quickly, good leadership decisions depend on understanding the technical details.

Lead and grow the team

  • Hire, onboard, and develop engineers, and build a team that works autonomously across platform engineering, infrastructure, and AI.
  • Hold regular 1:1s, set clear expectations, and agree individual development plans with each engineer.
  • Give timely feedback, recognise strong performance, and address low performance early.
  • Create an environment of trust, open communication, and continuous learning, so the team keeps up with a fast-moving field without burning out.

Own delivery and operations

  • Own end-to-end delivery, from planning and estimation through implementation and release, balancing new capabilities with reliability and maintenance.
  • Make sure the platform runs well in production: on-call, incident handling, and service levels for the systems other teams rely on.
  • Spot risks and blockers early and resolve them, or escalate in time with a clear proposal.
  • Turn the AI strategy into quarterly goals and a roadmap the team commits to, together with your manager and stakeholders.

Run the platform as a product

  • Work with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to understand their needs and decide what the platform should offer next.
  • Measure adoption, reliability, cost, and impact, and use that data in planning and when reporting to leadership.
  • Manage the cost of AI usage and tooling, including budgets, licences, vendor relationships, and build-versus-buy decisions.

Shape the technical direction

  • Work with the team's tech leads on architecture and key technical decisions, and stay hands-on in design discussions, reviews, and selected implementation work.
  • Work with security, legal, and compliance colleagues to keep the platform and the company's use of AI secure and compliant.
  • Help engineering teams across Raisin adopt AI in their work through documentation, workshops, and direct support.

Your Profile

What you bring

  • 3+ years leading engineers as an Engineering Manager, Engineering Lead, or Team Lead, including hiring and performance management.
  • 7+ years in software engineering overall, with a background in backend, platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling.
  • Experience leading a team that builds for internal customers, such as a platform, developer tooling, or shared services used by other engineers.
  • A track record of delivering production systems that other teams depend on, including ownership of their reliability.
  • A practical understanding of modern AI integration, such as LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, and agentic workflows, deep enough to evaluate technical decisions and challenge the team. You use AI tools in your own work.
  • Clear communication with engineers, product, and business stakeholders, and fluency in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI platform topics such as model access, governance, observability, rate limiting, or cost management.
  • You have driven adoption of new tools or practices across an engineering organisation.
  • Experience leading distributed or hybrid teams.
  • Experience in a regulated industry such as banking or fintech.

You don't need to tick every box. If you have led a platform or developer-tooling team and you are excited about what AI changes for engineering, we would like to hear from you.

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | Germany | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Germany.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will: 

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
  • Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
  • Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

We’re excited about you because you have

  • 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
  • Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
  • Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
  • Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
  • Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud
  • Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products
  • Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners
  • Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 124,571 - EUR 149,485. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany or Sweden.

Senior Software Engineer - Security Assurances

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance to join our GRC engineering team. We are building a security system that’s automated at scale, rigorously data-driven, and built from the ground up with defense-in-depth and self-healing in mind. We support a highly autonomous, remote-first, cloud-native organization. We are a technical team that can build any tool we need, while knowing when to buy to improve velocity.

To support our growth and ambitious vision, we embrace agile principles and values, share openly, apply context-driven security mechanisms, default to action, and have an OSS-first mindset. We are a 100% remote company. We believe in high-velocity but sustainable expectations and timeframes, giving people the room to do great work.

The Opportunity:

You will work to build out our security observability, compliance, and control management systems and tools. You will develop services and tools to proactively defend our systems, provide visibility to our security state, and give engineers and stakeholders guardrails and paved roads to behave securely. You will collaborate across your team, the security department, and wider Grafana to write and deploy security policies across all of our SDLC, applications, and infrastructure.

This is a very technical, hands-on keyboard software engineering, so development experience is critical. You will ideally have some experience building, implementing and improving the maturity of security programs in Cloud-based SaaS organizations. Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc) is useful, but the disposition to quickly learn new things is more important than rote knowledge. You will work alongside other security engineers, full-stack developers, and customer-facing teams. Experience guiding and negotiating with peers, stakeholders, customers, and auditors is a plus. 

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be a technical contributor on our GRC team covering a range of areas, including certifications, application, build, cloud, and supply chain security, and internal security tooling development
  • Develop, implement, and maintain highly automated security assurance programs to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, PCI-DSS, TISAX, whatever else our customers eventually throw at us)
  • Develop systems, automations, and methods of security observability to push the GRC engineering organization beyond just meeting certification requirements

tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry

  • Construction has some of the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM. At Kuro, you can tackle some of the hardest problems in applied AI every day

  • Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions. Backed by an €10 million seed round, we already process more than 1 million pages every month and expect that volume to grow 10x over the next six months.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

What You'll Do

Set the technical direction

  • Own the architecture decisions for the platform, from document ingestion to the chat UI

  • Write and review RFCs. The technical roadmap for the next two to three quarters is yours.

  • Make the build-or-buy decisions: which models we use, and which retrieval and orchestration stack we build on.

  • Turn a vague customer request (“show me where the bid deviates from the BoQ”) into a scoped plan with the risks named.

Raise the bar for the team

  • Mentor engineers: Review their designs and their code.

  • Define the engineering standards. Find what slows the team down, in tooling or in the CI/CD pipeline, and fix it.

  • Interview and hire engineers.

  • You have no direct reports. You change decisions in product and in other teams with a written argument.

Build and own end-to-end (AI) features

  • Design and implement new features to solve a specific user problem, such as document versioning or our agentic Chat.

  • From concept to DB schema, to optimizing LLMs, to UI. Own the full development lifecycle of customer-facing features.

  • Manage evaluations and scoring, and perform error analysis on new and shipped AI features.

Build the platform that abstracts workflow building

  • Contribute to the workflow harness, decision-trace standard, and eval tooling so a new use case ships in ~1 month

  • Build reusable human review & approval surfaces where trust in AI output is earned

Work on the construction ontology & project graph

  • Help model and evolve canonical entities of our customers

  • Contribute to entity resolution across sources: recognizing the same requirement, position, or price across BoQs, contracts, drawings, and bids

  • Build features so answers are evidence-linked and auditable, and decisions flow back into the graph

Contribute to scalable data pipelines & integrations

  • Extend our multi-modal ingestion of unstructured documents - PDFs, scans, drawings, and 3D models - orchestrated and cost-efficient at scale

  • Build read/write integrations with customer systems (document management, ERP/AVA), so workflows complete work end-to-end

Projects you would be involved in

Current & Past projects

  • Project & document versioning guaranteeing data lineage in construction projects

  • German tokenizer for construction-specific search

  • Document pipeline ingesting 10,000s of PDFs per day

  • Native BIM/DWG file support: ingesting and processing 3D models

  • Design the ontology v1 + graph schema: core construction entities, evidence links, and per-customer extension model

  • Build out our workflow harness to run agentic workflows for customers

Current Tech Stack

It is still day 0 for Kuro. Therefore, we are highly pragmatic with our tool choices. We believe in keeping it simple and moving quickly. You significantly help shape our tech stack decisions.

  • Web-App: Typescript

  • Database / Vector DB and File Storage: AWS RDS / Trubopuffer / AWS S3

  • Backend: Fastify API + Prisma ORM

  • Workflow Orchestrator: Prefect (Python)

  • Hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk

  • AI: Azure / OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, AWS

  • Obsv., Eval. & Tracking: Langfuse, Datadog

Your profile

This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product

  • Bring 6+ years of experience as a Staff (full-stack) software engineer or Technical Lead, in a fast-paced environment

  • Have proven experience delivering production-grade applied AI features to customers

  • Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features

  • Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact

  • Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English

  • Enjoy working onsite with the team at our office in Factory Berlin Mitte every day

Bonus Points

  • You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup

  • You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these!

  • German-speaking (definitely not a must, we’re fully international)

Why Kuro

You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph.

As Kuro grows, you can grow with it, whether as a leading individual contributor, technical leader or people manager.

 

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Call – Intro, motivation, logistics & fit (30 min)

  • Impact Interview – Deep dive into your experience, ownership & impact (60 min)

  • On-site Day

    • System Design – Designing under ambiguity & LLM craft (45 min)

    • AI-Native Coding – Hands-on coding with AI (45 min)

    • Final Culture Interview (approx. 60 min)

  • Reference calls

  • Decision

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.

 

What you will do

  • Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture.

  • Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it.

  • Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading.

  • Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them

  • At least 8 years of experience building and running software in production, including systems where errors cost real money.

  • Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot.

  • A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title.

  • Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance.

  • Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • AI is part of your daily work. Experience building or evaluating AI agents in production is a strong plus.

  • Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus

 

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin, hybrid

  • Working language: English

  • A learning budget for your development

  • Start date: As soon as possible

raw.title: Field Service Engineer – Semiconductor Equipment (f/m/d)
raw.description:
Description

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across Taiwan, the United States, and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Field Service Engineer, you'll take hands-on ownership of our systems throughout their operational lifecycle — from installation and commissioning to preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.

You'll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You'll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join Quantum Diamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

What will you do

  • Install, commission, and qualify our quantum sensing systems at customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when deeper technical expertise is required.

  • Take ownership of system reliability and technical service, working closely with Field Application Engineers who focus on measurement execution and customer applications.

  • Manage spare-parts availability for your installed base, including inventory tracking, consumption planning, replenishment, and coordination of service logistics.

  • Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers by providing clear technical communication, reliable support, and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments.

  • Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, documentation, and training materials.

What is expected of you

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Field Service Engineer, Equipment Engineer, or in a comparable technical service role, ideally working with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

  • Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software.

  • Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures.

  • Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications.

  • Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, even when working under time pressure.

  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with different stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel internationally for approximately 80% of your working time, primarily supporting customer installations across the US, Europe, and Asia.

  • Fluency in English; German, Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean would be a plus.

  • A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: Operations Intern / Working Student (Supply Chain & Procurement) (f/m/d)
description: Beschreibung Du möchtest erleben, was es braucht, um ein Deep-Tech-Unternehmen von den ersten Prototypen bis hin zur globalen Produktion zu skalieren? Bei uns erwartet dich kein Praktikum, bei dem du nur zuschaust. Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für echte operative Aufgaben , unterstützt unser Tagesgeschäft und hilfst aktiv dabei, strukturierte und skalierbare Prozesse aufzubauen, die mit QuantumDiamonds mitwachsen. Deine Aufgaben Du erhältst praxisnahe Einblicke in verschiedene Bereiche unseres Operations-Teams und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für eigene Themen, sobald du dich bei QD eingearbeitet hast. Einkauf & Lieferantenmanagement Unterstütze das operative Tagesgeschäft im Einkauf – von der Erstellung von Bestellanforderungen und Bestellungen bis hin zur Nachverfolgung von Lieferungen. Behalte Bestellungen, Lieferzeiten und mögliche Verzögerungen im Blick und hilf dabei, Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen. Unterstütze bei Bedarf die Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit unseren Lieferanten. Logistik & Versand Koordiniere ein- und ausgehende Sendungen, einschließlich Versanddokumentation, Abholungen sowie gegebenenfalls Zoll- und Exportdokumenten. Sorge dafür, dass Materialien und Komponenten reibungslos zwischen Lieferanten, unseren Laboren, der Produktion und anderen internen Teams transportiert werden. Unterstütze beim Wareneingang und stelle sicher, dass Materialien bei den richtigen Personen und am richtigen Ort ankommen. Bestandsmanagement & ERP Hilf dabei, Materialverfügbarkeit und Lagerbestände transparent zu halten, damit unsere Teams jederzeit über die benötigten Komponenten verfügen. Pflege Lieferanten-, Einkaufs-, Bestands- und Materialdaten in unserem Odoo-ERP-System und stelle deren Aktualität und Genauigkeit sicher. Unterstütze uns dabei, unsere ERP-Daten strukturiert, zuverlässig und für unser weiteres Wachstum nutzbar zu halten. Prozesse & Operations-Projekte Identifiziere Möglichkeiten, unsere Logistik-, Einkaufs- und Supply-Chain Prozesse einfacher, effizienter und skalierbar zu gestalten, und hilf aktiv bei der Umsetzung. Unterstütze bei Datenanalysen, Dokumentationen und weiteren Operations-Projekten – abhängig von deinen Interessen und den aktuellen Prioritäten des Teams. Arbeite eng mit Engineering, Produktion und anderen Teams zusammen, um alltägliche operative Herausforderungen zu lösen. Übernimm Verantwortung Je mehr du in deine Rolle hineinwächst, desto mehr Verantwortung möchten wir dir für eigene operative Themen übertragen. Ob du offene Bestellungen und Lieferzeiten im Blick behältst, unseren Wareneingang optimierst oder dafür sorgst, dass unsere ERP-Daten und Prozesse mit dem Wachstum von QD Schritt halten können – bei uns kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen. Das bringst Du mit Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Logistik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich eingeschrieben, oder hast ein solches Studium abgeschlossen. Du stehst entweder für ein sechsmonatiges Vollzeitpraktikum oder als Werkstudent für mindestens sechs Monate zur Verfügung. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig und hast Freude daran, Ordnung und klare Abläufe zu schaffen. Unsere Benefits Mission : Bei QD geht es um mehr als nur großartige Produkte – wir wollen einen nachhaltigen Unterschied machen. Du arbeitest an sinnstiftenden Aufgaben, die über das Tagesgeschäft hinausgehen. Impact & Wachstum: Du steigst in einer spannenden Phase ein, in der deine Meinung zählt. Du gestaltest Kultur und Entscheidungen aktiv mit und wächst mit einem schnell skalierenden Unternehmen. Work-Life-Balance: Erholung ist uns wichtig. Freu dich auf 12 Urlaubstage plus gesetzliche Feiertage. Gesundheit & Fitness: Mit einer von uns finanzierten Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft hast du Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitnessstudios, Kursen und Wellnessangeboten in ganz Deutschland. Team & Kultur: Die besten Ideen entstehen im Austausch. Regelmäßige Offsites und Teamevents sorgen für ein starkes, unterstützendes Miteinander. Ownership & Beteiligung: Über unser Beteiligungsprogramm bist du direkt am gemeinsamen Erfolg beteiligt. Über uns QuantumDiamonds GmbH mit Hauptsitz in München entwickelt und fertigt Halbleiter-Inspektionssysteme auf Basis von Quantensensorik. Das 2022 aus der Technischen Universität München gegründete Unternehmen nutzt Stickstoff-Fehlstellen-Zentren (NV-Zentren) in Diamanten, um elektrische Ströme mit Mikrometer-Präzision innerhalb fortschrittlicher 2,5D- und 3D-Chiparchitekturen abzubilden. Neun der zehn weltweit größten Halbleiterhersteller arbeiten bereits mit QuantumDiamonds zusammen, mit Systemen, die in Europa, den USA und Asien im Einsatz sind. Das Unternehmen investiert 152 Millionen Euro in den Bau der weltweit ersten Produktionsanlage für Halbleiter-Inspektionswerkzeuge auf Basis von Quantensensorik, gefördert im Rahmen des European Chips Act. How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

  • Regression suites: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

  • Coverage estimation: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

  • Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

Pillar

Driving question

Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.

Engineering

Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.

Data Science

Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

You are here to scale up data generation. Design teams can hand us 10⁶ sequences, and our automated infrastructure measures on the order of 10³ of them individually. Library construction and display is what closes that gap.

We want someone who has set these systems up before and can do it again here, with their own hands. Phage, ribosome, mRNA, yeast, cell-free: which one fits depends on the library and the target, and part of the job is making that call and then building it rather than writing a recommendation.

This is a build role, not a service role. For your first months you are making libraries, running selections, working out why a round collapsed, and turning what works into something the automation team can run without you.

What You'll Do

  • Build the libraries. Oligo pools, combinatorial assembly, barcoding. More campaigns fail here than at selection.

  • Run selections end to end, including the call on whether a round enriched real binders or just fast growers.

  • Pick the platform per campaign and stand it up. Based on the library and the target, not on what you happened to use last.

  • Own the sequencing analysis. You don't need to be a bioinformatician, but you can't be waiting on one.

  • Hand off to automation. A protocol that only works when you personally run it isn't finished.

  • Close the loop. Selected designs get expressed and measured on BLI and SPR by the team next door. That tells you whether the selection worked.

What We're Looking For

  • MSc / PhD in molecular biology, protein engineering, or a relevant field, plus 3+ years running display and selection yourself.

  • You have set up a display platform, not just used one. This is the core requirement. Built the library, got the selection working, and produced binders that held up in an independent assay. Managing outsourced CRO campaigns is not the same thing.

  • Depth in at least one display format and working literacy across the rest. We are not fixed on which one.

  • High-diversity cloning, and an understanding of where bias enters a pool and what it costs you later.

  • NGS as a routine tool, and FACS if you have it.

  • Enough Python or R to analyze your own data without joining a queue.

  • You use AI tools seriously. It's 2026 and we run on Claude Code across the company. You also need the judgment to check what comes back.

  • A self-starter. Nobody is going to hand you a prioritized queue. You decide what to build, build it, and tell us what you learned.

  • Startup speed, not academic pace. Campaigns run against customer deadlines. A working platform with known limits beats an elegant one next year.

  • You want your protocols automated rather than manual forever.

If your instinct is that a campaign is finished once you have ten good clones, we will frustrate each other. We want data, not a hit list.

Details

  • Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: ASAP

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

This is an internship for an exceptional molecular biologist who wants to do the most serious work of their life so far. You won't shadow people or run busywork — you'll own real production workflows: cloning, protein expression, purification, and characterization, on the systems that serve our customers every day.

We run a high-throughput, heavily automated lab, and we hold interns to the same bar as the rest of the team. We'll give you hard problems and a senior person to learn from, and expect you to make a real dent. For us, an internship is also the best way to find people we want to keep — do great work, and we'll want to bring you on full-time afterwards.

What You'll Do

  • Run molecular cloning and protein production end to end: PCR, assembly, transformation, expression (bacterial and/or mammalian), and purification.

  • Execute and improve QC on constructs and proteins (capillary electrophoresis, sequencing, SDS-PAGE) and characterization assays (binding, expression, stability).

  • Take a workflow that's flaky or slow and make it reliable and faster — better protocols, better automation, fewer failures.

  • Work hands-on with liquid handlers and lab automation, and help push manual protocols toward automated ones.

  • Bring rigor to your data: document precisely, track samples, and make your results reproducible and traceable.

  • Diagnose failures across biology, reagents, and instruments — and fix them, not just flag them.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong hands already. You've done real molecular biology — PCR, cloning, transformation, electrophoresis, ideally protein expression and purification — through research, a project, or a prior internship, and you're good at it. Protocols don't intimidate you.

  • BSc / MSc student or recent graduate in molecular biology, biochemistry, or a relevant field.

  • Automation- and software-curious. You'd rather automate a tedious step than repeat it 200 times. Comfort with scripting (Python) or liquid-handling automation is a strong plus.

  • Self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting for someone to hand you the next step.

  • AI-native. It's 2026 — you use AI tools as a default to learn faster and work smarter.

  • High standards and high drive. You care that the experiment is right, you move fast, and you're excited that the robots run real customer experiments.

Details

  • Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: Flexible

  • Duration: Minimum 6 months

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance.
